observations: Photo 0: Silver laptop open on a wooden table, screen off, HP logo visible on bezel, Intel Core sticker on palm rest, business-style keyboard, trackpad, and a business card in front.
Photo 1: Same laptop with screen on, showing Windows 11 blue wallpaper, wrapped in plastic, placed on a shelf with other electronics in the background. 'ELITEBOOK' text visible on palm rest.

Photo 2: Laptop screen on, showing a desktop with a dramatic wallpaper (child on shoulders in smoke), HP logo on bezel, 'ELITEBOOK' on palm rest, Intel Core sticker, and a hand holding the left side of the laptop.
All photos show a watermark 'VISION WORLD COMPUTER'.
No visible damage to the chassis or screen in any photo.
No ports, battery, or underside shown.

claims.claim: UK Used Business HP EliteBook 745 G6
claims.evidence: Model name 'EliteBook 745 G6' is stated by seller and 'ELITEBOOK' is visible on palm rest in photo 1 and 2.
Photo 0, 1, and 2 all show an Intel Core sticker on the palm rest, indicating an Intel processor, not AMD Ryzen 5 Pro.
No system information or BIOS screen shown; RAM cannot be verified from photos alone.
No disk management or system info screen shown; SSD size cannot be verified from photos.
No GPU information visible; '2gb Dedicated' likely refers to graphics memory, but no proof in photos.
